title: AAPS 3.2.0.2 crashes on basal temp attempt -> No connection to ruffy...
symptom: AAPS 3.2.0.2 (master) crashes every time a new basal temp is accepted. The log shows 'No connection to ruffy. Pump control unavailable.' at the time of crash.
fix: Restarting setup from scratch, including all objectives, solved the issue.
evidence_quote: restarting setup from scratch, including all objectives solved this issue.
